name: Building Monuments
overview: Building monuments in Scripture symbolizes the act of remembering God's faithfulness and His mighty works, grounded in the truth that God is the Creator of all (Genesis 1:1) and the source of eternal life through Christ (John 3:16, John 14:6). These memorials serve as tangible expressions of faith—confidence in the unseen promises of God (Hebrews 11:1)—and reminders that all things work together for good to those who love Him (Romans 8:28). Ultimately, such monuments point believers to the revelation of Jesus Christ and the hope of His coming (Revelation 1:1).
